# NNPA Internals

Reference material that nnpa-performance and the other task skills in this directory link to. For per-op limits see docs/SupportedONNXOps-NNPA.md; for usage see docs/AccelNNPAHowToUseAndTest.md.

Read only the reference you need:

- [NNPA Broadcasting Support](references/nnpa-broadcasting.md): Which NNPA operations tolerate input operands of different shapes, and what happens when they don't match exactly.
- [NNPA ZTensor Data Layouts](references/nnpa-ztensor-layouts.md): Every ZTensor (`ZTensorEncodingAttr`) carries a `DataLayout` value that determines how its logical dimensions are tiled into the physical 6D stick layout NNPA hardware operates on.
- [SIMD Code Generation for Stick/Unstick Operations](references/stick-unstick-simd-codegen.md): SIMD vectorized code for stickification and unstickification is generated by onnx-mlir during the ZHighToZLow lowering phase, using compile-time template instantiation to emit Krnl/Affine/SCF loop constructs that leverage vector operations.
- [NNPA Accelerator Path](references/accelerators.md) (selected sections): The NNPA (Neural Network Processing Assist) is IBM's hardware accelerator for neural network inference, integrated into the z16 Telum processor.
